notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b003:l010: Kongurbai’s argali, duck, and fox are possessive images for secure game or dominion; whether any is also a named scout is left open.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b003:l019: Атагым бар чоң улук is a compressed self-description as a renowned great noble; its exact syntax with the following Kakan line is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b003:l025: Ашкере каны коюлуп literally says Algara’s manifest blood thickened; the intended equine condition after hard travel is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b003:l036: Ийнине суур ыштаткын orders marmot fur or pelts sewn/smoked onto the herders’ shoulders; the garment construction is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b005:l007: Кылам түз literally 'I make straight' is a threat toward challengers; 'straighten out' preserves the idiom.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b005:l019: Булгаарыдан тердигим identifies Kongurbai’s leather saddlecloth; its connection to the following boast is formulaic.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0007:b005:l026: Искендер тийбес describes Beijing as beyond even Alexander’s reach; Iskender is interpreted as Alexander in the epic formula.

transcription_check.details: Rendered Semetey volume 2 PDF page 7 at 1200-pixel scale and visually checked both printed columns against extracted coordinates and block structure. All 78 narrative positions are present in printed reading order, with 5 nonverse positions explicitly excluded. No independent manuscript collation.

alignment_check.details: Every extracted narrative row was paired in order with one directly translated English row. Repetitions, names, numbers, and page transitions were retained; material uncertainties are noted by source ID.

translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from the extracted text and rendered source page. No prior English translation or external machine-translation output used. Same-agent visual and alignment checks only; no independent specialist review.
